docs.title: Week 1 — Project PPT
docs.text: Worked on the system workflow and technical aspects of the presentation. I helped explain how users would select resources, check availability and submit booking requests. I also helped with the final formatting and compilation of the PPT.

docs.title: Week 2 — Project Proposal
docs.text: Worked on the Methodology, Feasibility and technical aspects of the proposal. I helped describe the proposed development approach and system functionality. I also contributed to compiling and checking the final LaTeX/PDF version.

docs.title: Week 3 — Use Case, DFDs & Revised Proposal
docs.text: Worked on the Level 2 DFD, breaking down the major processes from the Level 1 diagram into detailed subprocesses. I checked the consistency between the Level 0, Level 1 and Level 2 diagrams. I also contributed to compiling and finalising the revised proposal in LaTeX and PDF format.

docs.title: Week 4 — Prototype Development + LaTeX/PDF Compilation
docs.text: Worked on the development and refinement of the working prototype of the Campus Booking System. I helped implement the main screens and booking workflow and checked the prototype functionality. I also worked on preparing the prototype document in LaTeX, compiling it into PDF and checking the final document for formatting and consistency.

docs.title: Week 1 — Project PPT
docs.text: Worked on preparing the initial project presentation. I contributed to the problem statement, motivation and need for the Campus Booking System. I also helped organise the introduction and objectives of the project in the PPT.

docs.title: Week 2 — Project Proposal
docs.text: Worked on the Problem Statement, Objectives and Scope sections of the project proposal. I helped organise the project goals and define what the proposed Campus Booking System would cover. I also reviewed the final content before converting it into PDF.

docs.title: Week 3 — Use Case, DFDs & Revised Proposal
docs.text: Worked on the Use Case Diagram of the Campus Booking System. I helped identify the major actors and their interactions with the system and organised the different use cases. I also contributed to revising the project proposal based on the updated diagrams and project requirements and checked the final content for consistency.

docs.title: Week 4 — ER Diagram + Prototype Documentation
docs.text: Worked on designing the Entity Relationship (ER) Diagram for the Campus Booking System. I identified the main entities, attributes and relationships required for the system and helped ensure that the database structure matched the project requirements. I also contributed to preparing the prototype documentation, including organising the content and explaining the main prototype features.

docs.title: Week 1 — Project PPT
docs.text: Worked on the proposed solution and major features of the system. I helped explain how the system can manage campus resources, bookings and permissions. I also reviewed the PPT content and helped improve its overall flow.

docs.title: Week 2 — Project Proposal
docs.text: Worked on preparing the LaTeX version of the project proposal. I arranged the sections, headings and formatting and helped maintain consistency throughout the document. I also checked the generated PDF for formatting issues.

docs.title: Week 3 — Use Case, DFDs & Revised Proposal
docs.text: Worked on the Level 0 and Level 1 Data Flow Diagrams. I helped identify the main entities, processes, data flows and data stores and represented the flow of information through the booking system. I also helped update and format the revised proposal, including the diagrams and document structure.

docs.title: Week 4 — Activity Diagram + Prototype Design
docs.text: Worked on creating the Activity Diagram of the Campus Booking System. I identified the different activities, decisions and flow of operations involved in the booking process. I also worked on developing the prototype, focusing on the user interface and overall navigation between different screens.
